status: confirmed from exact119 debug ELF and DWARF

proc_modules.address: core_layout.base, or zero under the m_show address-hiding branch
proc_modules.disassembly: m_show rsi points to module.list (module+0x8); loads [rsi+0x140] and adds [rsi+0x190], therefore module+0x148 and module+0x198; when addresses are shown, loads [r13+0x138], therefore module+0x140

sysfs.bindings: modinfo_coresize.attr.name=coresize and .show=show_coresize; corresponding initsize binding also confirmed

successful_initialization.interpretation: successful initialization clears init_layout.base and init_layout.size before returning; stable completed loads should have initsize=0 and proc size=coresize
successful_initialization.limit: binary control flow is not a sample of any particular guest module state; retain actual initstate and sysfs/proc cross-checks

resource_observer_interpretation: Use the actual visible core base and sysfs coresize for the core-layout interval. The proc total does not provide the init base and must not be treated as a contiguous allocation from the core base. Never infer or probe a freed init extent from that total.
scope: code+data core-layout field interpretation only; no runtime guest, host module operation, source download, core code change, or whole-module memory accounting
